items.title: Shared compact bucket and future-time contract
items.precondition: The isolated execution worktree has the T1 helper change and a fixed reference instant available for direct helper inspection or an equivalent focused check.
steps: Evaluate valid past instants in the now, minute, hour, day, week, month, and year buckets against one fixed now value.
Confirm representative results are now, 8min, 4hr, 2d, 3w, 5mo, and 1yr, with the existing rounding and boundary behavior retained.
Evaluate a future instant at least 45 seconds away and an invalid input.
items.expected: Past output is compact with no ago suffix; a future bucket outputs in Nunit; sub-45-second output is now; invalid input remains an empty string.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: Deterministic tsx check at 2026-08-07T12:00:00.000Z returned now, 8min, 4hr, 2d, 3w, 5mo, 1yr, in 8min, and an empty string for invalid input.
items.notes: No frontend test runner exists; verified with a focused deterministic tsx invocation without adding a test framework.

items.title: Comment and reply timestamps sit beside the author name
items.precondition: An isolated authenticated runtime has a feed post with top-level comments and at least one reply spanning multiple relative-time buckets.
steps: Open its detail/comments surface and inspect a root comment and an indented reply.
Confirm each timestamp follows the author display name in the comment bubble header, not the Like/Reply action row.
Hover each rendered time element and activate Like and Reply.
items.expected: Root-comment and reply labels use the shared compact text beside the author name; each retains a readable absolute datetime tooltip; Like/Reply controls remain in the meta row and work without an identity, count, or layout regression.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: Human verified by user in the running app. Root-comment and reply times appear beside the author name, retain their hover title, and Like/Reply remain usable below.
items.notes: This is the sole approved layout change in the plan.

items.title: Message surfaces retain compact text and existing hover behavior
items.precondition: An isolated authenticated runtime has a conversation list, an open message thread, and a search result with known timestamps.
steps: Inspect the last-message timestamp in a conversation row and hover it.
Inspect a message-bubble timestamp and hover it.
Search messages and inspect the result metadata timestamp.
items.expected: Conversation rows, message bubbles, and search results share compact labels. Existing conversation-row and bubble hover titles remain absolute; search-result structure remains unchanged.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: Human verified by user in the running app as part of the completed timestamp change acceptance.
items.notes: Search results do not render a time element or hover title; no new layout or markup was introduced.

items.title: Notifications retain compact text, hover time, and future distinction
items.precondition: An isolated authenticated runtime has at least one notification timestamp and a safe fixture or deterministic check for a future relative-time value.
steps: Open Notifications and inspect and hover a timestamp.
Verify a future value through the deterministic A1 check or a fixture.
items.expected: Notification labels use compact output while their absolute hover title remains intact; future output remains visibly prefixed with in after the now bucket.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: Human verified by user in the running app as part of the completed timestamp change acceptance.
items.notes: No API or notification-state behavior is in scope.
